answers.core: Unless I have missed something, there is currently no way to truly map an `InputEventAction` back to the source device. That seems like a core oversight to me...?
answers.workaround: It could default to unknown if the user creates an event manually but does not set the device type. (Thus ignoring it would be fine, if they don't need it.)

title: Add a way to get source device type from `InputEventAction`
